title: Amdahl's law, measured
prompt: A pipeline has a parallelizable part P and a serial fraction S (S + P = 1). Implement `static double Speedup(double serialFraction, int cores)` returning Amdahl's speedup S(n) = 1 / (S + P/n) — and `static int BreakEvenCores(double serialFraction, double minSpeedup)` returning the smallest core count whose speedup reaches minSpeedup (return -1 if no finite core count reaches it). The test checks the hard ceiling: with 10% serial work, no number of cores beats 10x.

tests.name: amdahl-values
tests.hint: Speedup = 1/(S + (1-S)/n). BreakEven: solve 1/(S + (1-S)/n) >= target for n, ceil it — unless S*target >= 1, then unreachable (-1).
